release_configuration.reason: The user fixed an undergraduate-scale two-stage, medium-small two-tower MVP.

commissioning_comparison_only.restriction: Removed modules are historical evidence only and are not part of the MVP BOM or assembly.

safety_zones.common: one_latching_estop_chain_removes hazardous energy in both towers
safety_zones.tower_a: common 24 V actuator contactor removes both shredder drives
safety_zones.tower_b: the same contactor removes extruder drive and fused heater branches
safety_zones.control_enclosure: one common grounded enclosure on Tower B lower rear
safety_zones.maintenance: one tower may remain logic-powered only; hazardous energy cannot follow a batch-bin or data connection
safety_zones.external_credit: workshop safety hardware may be credited only after model rating channel and fault-test inventory

mandatory_physical_gates: Confirm floor/workbench anchor substrate and achieve at least 1 kN pullout per point with the selected fastener system.
Measure final module masses and center of gravity; rerun the model before powered motion.
Verify maximum input lip height against the actual operator and refill container.
Run both shredder stages and coast-down tests while logging Tower A and optical-rail acceleration.
Prove every chute boot and batch-bin docking path can be removed and cleaned without opening a cutter guard.
model_limits: Module masses are conservative planning estimates, not donor measurements.
Rigid-body tipping does not model profile-joint compliance, floor flexibility, resonance, impact or anchor edge distance.
The straight forming rail is retained because hot filament bend radius and solidification are not physically validated.
